high-severity-risks-mitigated.reason: ⚠️ RE-EVALUATED 2026-09-02 AGAINST THE EXPANDED GRAPH, not carried forward. Each high-severity risk the layer introduces now has a decided mitigation in the graph rather than a position in a document: unscoped credential inheritance is answered by the provider credential contract and proved by sentinel tests with a control; the silently untrusted child is answered by capability-signature verification, which is the detection half of #67 and is now an authored task rather than an acknowledged gap; the lookalike readiness response is answered by the run-identity health endpoint with an unrelated-server negative control; undisclosed billing is answered by the separately authorised canary; and tracked runtime state is answered by coverage-before-data. ⚠️ ONE MITIGATION IS WEAKER THAN DESIGNED AND THE CRITERION IS SATISFIED ANYWAY, WITH THE LIMIT STATED. Windows injects nine home and user variables into every child whatever the allowlist says (AST-0045), so the boundary cannot be an upper bound there. What is provable — that no unrelated secret crosses — is what the criteria now claim. A mitigation whose limit is measured and written down is mitigated; one whose limit is unknown is not.
